Independent semantic/destructive review, authorized merge, exact-main closure and a separate implementation work order are required. This unchanged declaration and docs/governance/trading_day_schedule_atomic_publication_v1.md must exist on BASE before any implementation PR. No runtime is authorized by this PR; no platform tuple, source/provider profile, signing/custody/verifier key or clock service is qualified; no same-PR implementation is authorized.

identity.name: Trading-Day Schedule artifact atomic publication v1
identity.purpose: Contract version trading-day-schedule-atomic-publication-v1. Independently govern one L4.1 six-file immutable schedule artifact, qualified same-filesystem atomic no-replace directory publication, and one cleanup attempt for proven current-invocation uncommitted staging. Physical integrity grants no provider/source/key/completion authority. Normative companion: docs/governance/trading_day_schedule_atomic_publication_v1.md.

implementation_bindings.rationale: One exact Windows-only qualified no-replace directory publication call for this invocation's sealed sibling staging; no replacement, fallback, retry or L3 authority reuse.

One recursive call site, at most one invocation attempt, only current-owned proven uncommitted staging. Exact Windows cleanup rebind precedes owner check when descendants were quiesced. No arbitrary path, final, prior residue, permission repair or ignored error.

initiators: Only a separately authorized future L4 materializer with explicit fully verified L4.1 immutable schedule/source/evidence/receipt facts and a pre-existing safe absolute output_root; no reader/provider/Catalog/CLI initiator.
authority_boundary.mutation_owner: src/market_vault/schedule_artifact/materialization.py owns exclusive current staging and the absent-to-published final boundary. INPUT / ARTIFACT AUTHORITY, PRIVATE STAGING OWNERSHIP and PUBLICATION SEAL are distinct. A logical schedule alone is not provider evidence; ownership alone cannot publish; a seal cannot authorize arbitrary cleanup.
forbidden_bypass_layers: No caller trust boolean/hash/token, supplied owner/seal, public enrollment path, callback, settings override, path-existence authority or unchecked caller-graph reread may create authority. Immutable working facts require full L4.1 validation before mutation.
No os.replace, Path.replace, Path.rename, shutil.move, copy+delete, delete+rename, final deletion, repair/quarantine, chmod/ACL repair, retry-overwrite or reboot-delayed move.
No L3 multi_source_cross_day_dataset_atomic_publication_v1 authority, L3 native capability admission or call-through reuse; no checker/exemption/CI/source/version change in this design PR.

Separate native boundary only: src/market_vault/schedule_artifact/materialization.py::_rename_directory_no_replace_linux has exactly one direct renameat2(root_fd, staging_name, root_fd, final_name, RENAME_NOREPLACE=1) call. Current AST detection does not count it; no fake binding. Independent source/native review must enforce exact arguments, flag, call count and no alternate dispatch.
No ordinary POSIX rename/renameat, RENAME_EXCHANGE/WHITEOUT, fallback primitive, wildcard, prospective transition or additional destructive site without separately approved prior design.

mutated_assets: Exclusively created <output_root>/.<schedule_artifact_id>.tmp-<nonce>/, exact 64 lowercase hex artifact ID and independently random 16-byte/32 lowercase hex nonce; creation-time private access and only six exclusive new regular members.
Exact final inventory, no subdirectories: schedule.json, source_snapshot.json, coverage_evidence.json, verification_receipt.json, manifest.json, _SUCCESS. Marker is exact empty bytes.
excluded_assets: Pre-existing output_root and every ancestor; materializer cannot create, repair, chmod, take ownership of or delete them. Root must be a dedicated output directory, not volume root/repository/source directory/artifact or artifact descendant.

Existing/racing final of any validity, unrelated siblings, historical staging, raw/source evidence, L3 artifacts/runtime/capability table/contracts, Catalog, provider infrastructure, keys and production data.

allowed_transitions.rationale: Inputs, root, platform and ancestry validated; final absent; exclusive sibling staging created and ownership captured.
Strict read-only existing-final verification proves exact requested equivalence; no staging.
Preflight or existing-final admission fails, or exclusive creation/ownership capture fails; no cleanup without proven new ownership.
All six exact members fully privately verified under L4.1; private single-use seal captures the verifier's admitted facts.
Preparation fails; at most one cleanup of exact current-owned partial-creation inventory.
One qualified atomic no-replace primitive positively succeeds after immediate full revalidation and Windows-only checked descendant quiescence if applicable; revoke cleanup immediately.
Late-existing or collision winner strictly verified equivalent AND own uncommitted staging cleanup succeeds, with exact Windows rebind when quiesced.
Seal drift, quiescence failure, definite noncommit error or invalid winner; only proven cleanup is permitted, otherwise preserve and report residue.
Interrupted or unclassifiable primitive outcome, including success-return/state-recording ambiguity; revoke cleanup, no rebind/rmtree/destructive probe.
Strict final reader reacquires final evidence, completes second physical closure and matches exact requested authority.
Final verification or return preparation fails after known commit; preserve final without rollback.

commit_point.durable_authority: Only successful qualified same-filesystem atomic NO-REPLACE directory publication is physical commit. Manifest, empty _SUCCESS and private seal are not commit. Revoke staging cleanup immediately. Atomic visibility is not a universal power-loss persistence guarantee; ambiguous primitive/state-recording interruption never grants cleanup.
commit_point.success_authoritative_when: Only strict L4 final reader verification with newly acquired final-path evidence, second physical closure and exact requested-authority comparison produces VERIFIED_FINAL. Existing/racing equivalence must pass the same reader and own loser cleanup if staging exists. No trusted success while COMMITTED_UNVERIFIED, COMMITTED_INVALID or PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN.

pre_commit: Before staging: no cleanup target. During writes, after four data/evidence files, after manifest, after _SUCCESS and after seal: only exact current exclusive-creation ledger can permit one cleanup; process loss leaves residue no later invocation may adopt.
Immediately before primitive, including partial checked-close failure: if primitive demonstrably not entered, Windows rebind and normal ownership proof are prerequisites to cleanup.
During primitive ambiguity or interruption across physical-success/state-recording: PUBLICATION_FAILED / PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN, no rebind/rmtree/destructive probe. Read-only recovery only.
post_commit: Immediately after successful primitive, cleanup is irrevocably revoked. Known success is COMMITTED_UNVERIFIED; lost certainty is PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN, never a precommit deletion opportunity.

During final verification/return preparation, failure becomes COMMITTED_INVALID with FINAL_VERIFICATION_FAILED as applicable; preserve final. Crash returns no verified success. New invocation verifies final read-only before anything else.
No rollback, final deletion, repair, quarantine, marker/manifest regeneration or permission change. Independently qualified platform evidence must state persistence limits; restart always verifies.

restorable: One cleanup attempt may remove only current-invocation proven uncommitted staging; preparation may have fewer than six files only when actual inventory equals the current exclusive-creation ledger. Missing already-owned members or unknown additions refuse cleanup. Cleanup ownership is independent of publication completeness.

Windows deliberate full/partial quiescence requires private rebind before _remove_tree's normal owner check: genuine owner, SEALED or FAILED_PRECOMMIT, current seal, staging root open/unchanged, definite noncommit, no prior cleanup attempt.

Reopen each closed descendant via scope.member(old.path, directory=old.directory), require exact original identity/filesystem/security/type plus fresh link/reparse/stream checks. Recheck still-open descendants. Collect replacements locally; exact six-member inventory and binding must match before installing all replacements together, then require owner binding == original seal binding and run the full owner check again.

Immediately before the single shutil.rmtree(owner.path), revalidate ancestry, staging root, security/filesystem, each member and exact extant ledger inventory. Set cleanup_attempted=true before destructive attempt; never retry. Where handles must close, validate first, checked-close owned staging/member handles, retain scope protection and immediately remove without hooks or writes.
non_restorable: Any missing/replaced member, identical-byte different object, changed filesystem/security/type, link/reparse/stream, extra child, ambiguous ancestry or unproved ownership means CLEANUP_REFUSED, retain residue and no rmtree. Close provisional rebind handles without rebaselining originals.

Successful or uncertain publication forbids cleanup/rebind, even if old staging path exists. No final or root deletion, prior-residue adoption/sweep, chmod/onerror repair, ignored cleanup failure or retry after partial removal.
Rebind restores only cleanup evidence, never seal reuse or another publication attempt. Permanent deletion of committed artifacts/existing user assets is unsupported.
interruption_detection: Track exact owner state, publication outcome, single-use seal, private quiescence-started marker and cleanup_attempted. Quiescence stays SEALED and is not new serialized/public authority. Mark it before first descendant close.

Preserve reason/state/original cause plus secondary CLEANUP_REFUSED or CLEANUP_FAILED and residue. A one-shot pending cleanup may finish while reporting FAILED_PRECOMMIT without a terminal state transition.

All 81 ordered state pairs are explicit: 11 allowed, 70 forbidden, including all terminal outgoing pairs and self-transition attempts. Remaining in a state for private bookkeeping is not a state transition; retries require a fresh invocation.

same_request_retry: Before staging creation check exact final: absent safe parent continues; present fully equivalent returns EXISTING_EQUIVALENT created_new_build=false without writes; invalid/unsafe/conflicting final fails untouched without staging.

Equivalence requires strict artifact ID/physical integrity/source/evidence/receipt binding, schedule_content_id, schedule_pin_id, scope/date range/archive clock and exact requested logical authority, with every canonical member matching requested immutable facts.
completed_retry: Strict read-only final verification only; no marker/manifest regeneration, rewriting, relocation, permission change or timestamp/latest winner.
conflicting_retry: Conflicting/corrupt race winner remains untouched. Verify it read-only before own loser cleanup/rebind; original failure remains reportable.

Equivalent race returns created_new_build=false only after winner verification AND successful proven own cleanup. Cleanup refusal/failure reports FAILED_PRECOMMIT with residue, never silent idempotent success.
Fresh invocation never adopts old staging, even if artifact ID/name/process metadata matches. No same-invocation second rename or cleanup retry.

lock_authority: Qualified native no-replace primitive is destination exclusion; an existence check is not a lock.
Exclusive creation with private native object ledger proves staging ownership; an exact issued single-use seal alone permits the one publication attempt for that owner.
Access controls must exclude untrusted mutation during check-to-primitive interval. Hostile kernel/administrator/equivalent-owner credentials are outside this boundary; hash scans are not locks.
lock_scope: Same held output root/ancestry, exact private staging root and six files, final sibling name and qualified local filesystem/volume. Cooperating invocations never access each other's staging.
under_lock_revalidation: Before each mutation recheck relevant native ancestry/root/object security; before publication revalidate every seal fact, complete inventory, identities, sizes/hashes, manifest bytes, marker and target.

After complete revalidation, if final appeared do not quiesce: verify it read-only. If absent, only Windows checked-closes ALL descendant handles while retaining staging root and scope/ancestor handles. Handle must be valid; CloseHandle success precedes marking it closed. Partial failure means zero rename calls and rebind before cleanup.
No callback, await, sleep, provider/network/current-time call, serialization, permission change, data write or arbitrary hook between final revalidation, Windows quiescence and primitive.
concurrent_behavior: Windows: one os.rename only on independently qualified exact tuple; native empty and nonempty destination refusal mandatory. Only qualified exact ERROR_FILE_EXISTS=80 / ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS=183 is known destination collision; WinError 5 or generic path errors cannot masquerade as collision.

Any ambiguous Windows primitive exception gives PUBLICATION_UNCERTAIN: no cleanup rebind/rmtree/rollback/final mutation. Success keeps staging root handle through rename, revokes cleanup and never reopens old staging descendants; final reader acquires new final evidence.

Linux: retained root fd and all source descriptors; one flag-1 renameat2. EEXIST collision; ENOTEMPTY collision only with fresh safe final-object proof; EXDEV filesystem mismatch; ENOSYS/EINVAL/ENOTSUP/EOPNOTSUPP/missing symbol unsupported. Definite other noncommit errno fails without fallback; cleanup still needs ownership. Interrupted/unclassifiable outcomes are uncertain with no cleanup.
Known race losers use read-only winner admission and independently proven own cleanup. No overwrite, delete-first, retry, repair or destructive probe of winner.

identities: Exact L4.1 immutable input authority and six-file canonical layout, including all source-contract/signature/coverage/session/archive/logical checks. Preserve existing schedule/source/evidence/artifact identity algorithms; no caller trust IDs.

Native root/ancestor/staging/member identities, security, expected types and same filesystem/volume/mount. Linux retained no-follow fstat device/inode/type/native links plus statx mount proof. Windows retained no-follow FileIdInfo volume serial/full128 FileId, FileAttributeTagInfo, FileStandardInfo single-link proof, stream checks, security descriptors and volume GUID/local evidence.

Private immutable single-use seal binds owner/invocation, schedule_artifact_id, exact root/staging/final binding, native root/ancestor/member and filesystem/security facts, sorted inventory/roles, sizes, SHA256, exact manifest bytes/hash, empty _SUCCESS, source_snapshot_id/hash, coverage_completion_evidence_id, schedule_content_id/pin_id and exact verified receipt bytes/hash/signature/contract/declaration.

Seal capture must equal complete private verifier-admitted physical facts. No unchecked reread, copy/replace/deserialization, direct/foreign/stale/replayed/caller seal or raw-path ownership is authority.
drift_behavior: Immediately before primitive require same current owner/seal, root/ancestry/staging/members/filesystem/security, exact inventory equality, identities/sizes/SHA256, manifest, empty marker and safe absent final. Any drift before entry means zero primitive calls.

Reject relative/drive-relative, empty/dot/dot-dot, control/NUL, trailing aliases/device names, UNC/network/extended caller namespace, ADS/extra streams, root escape, all symlinks/junctions/reparse tags, hard-linked files, FIFO/device/socket, mount/volume transition and unknown objects. resolve() or path/mtime/size alone is insufficient.

Protected output/member objects reject all untrusted mutation grants. Ordinary ancestors do not inherit any volume-root exception and reject DELETE, FILE_DELETE_CHILD, WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER or other protected-chain replacement authority.

Only a held directory proven the exact native local volume GUID root by GetVolumePathNameW, GetVolumeNameForVolumeMountPointW, GetFinalPathNameByHandleW and stable FileIdInfo may tolerate root DELETE/write/append/EA/attributes that cannot mutate the separately protected child. Still reject FILE_DELETE_CHILD, WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER, GENERIC_ALL/raw GENERIC_WRITE and every reparse. Caller C:\ text or boolean never establishes root status.

Private protected access is supplied at creation, never repaired later. Untrusted mutation control must be proved. Missing/zero/unreliable native identity or denied checks fail closed; no L3 qualification borrowing.

authoritative_evidence: One successful qualified no-replace commit followed by strict L4 FINAL reader, fresh identities, full semantic/integrity validation, second physical closure and requested-authority comparison.
Strict equivalent existing-final read-only verification; for race/late-final paths additionally proven own staging cleanup, including complete Windows rebind when quiesced.
non_success_evidence: Marker, manifest, caller hashes, logical schedule alone, partial inventory, ownership without seal, seal without exact issued context, exists(), cleanup completion, mocked happy path or L3 native tuple admission.

Publication integrity does not prove provider truth, complete closure coverage, source/profile/key/clock admission. L4_MOOMOO_ONLY_AUTHORITY=REJECTED and L4_V1_PROVIDER_MODEL=PROVIDER_QUALIFICATION_DEFERRED remain frozen.
integrity_binding: Final/complete staging exact six-file inventory, no subdirectories/extras/hidden files/case aliases/streams. All JSON and manifest meet L4.1 canonical/semantic/resource bounds before seal. Manifest and empty _SUCCESS remain in the seal, outside manifest.output_files.

Recompute source_snapshot_id/source_content_hash, coverage_completion_evidence_id, schedule_content_id/pin_id and physical artifact ID through unchanged L4.1 rules; no native object ID/path/ownership/seal field enters logical content identity.

Reader independently reacquires FINAL facts after commit; repeat native ancestry/inventory/identity/size/SHA/manifest/empty-marker closure immediately before return. Identical-byte object replacement still fails.

invalidation_triggers.rationale: No UI/plan authority; immediate input/owner/seal/native revalidation supersedes all earlier inspections.

confirmation_invalidation.rationale: No deletion UI or caller confirmation capability. Independent design/base approval and separate runtime authorization are prerequisites, not mutable runtime trust flags.

execution_policy.rationale: Only the future private L4 materializer operation; reader/provider/Catalog/CLI have no mutation dispatch authority.

lifecycle_unit: One <output_root>/schedule_artifact_id=<64lowerhex>/ directory with exactly schedule.json, source_snapshot.json, coverage_evidence.json, verification_receipt.json, manifest.json and empty _SUCCESS. No subdirectories or other artifact cohort.
partial_mutation: Exact order: immutable L4.1 input/root/platform/final admission; exclusive private staging with ownership; four data/evidence files; manifest; complete five-file private verification; exclusive empty marker; complete six-file private verification; seal; immediate full revalidation; late-final read-only path or Windows descendant quiescence then one no-replace primitive; revoke cleanup; strict final reader/second closure/comparison; success.

Initial five-file verification differs from final semantics only in staging name and marker absence. Complete verification before seal has all six files and no weakened source/evidence/receipt rules. Close content-write handles before verification.

No platform qualified here. Future exact-code/exact-tuple native reader/writer/cleanup qualification is independent of L3. Unknown tuples, mocks/family names/version ranges/env bypasses are unsupported. Record OS/build/kernel/CPU/Python/native API/libc/filesystem/options/volume/mount/security evidence and durability limits.
rollback_expectation: Known precommit failure: only one current-owned cleanup, with Windows partial/full-quiescence rebind where needed. Failure/refusal preserves reported residue; no retries.
Committed or uncertain outcome: no rollback, final deletion/repair/quarantine, cleanup rebind or rmtree. Recovery/retry begins read-only in a new invocation.

retained_dependents: Pre-existing root/ancestors, source/provider evidence, custody/verifier keys, L2/L3 schedules/identities/runtime/artifacts/capability table/publication contract, existing/racing final, unrelated siblings and all historical residue remain untouched.
refused_cases: Unqualified source/provider/key/clock/completion or caller-supplied trust, invalid input, unsafe/unproved ancestry, remote/unqualified platform, unreliable object proof, cross-volume/mount, invalid/reused seal, missing/extra/replaced/security-drifted member or corrupt/conflicting final.

Error envelope retains reason, publication state, original cause and secondary cleanup/residue. Boundary reasons: INPUT_AUTHORITY, PLATFORM_UNQUALIFIED, UNSAFE_PATH, FILESYSTEM_MISMATCH, INVENTORY_MISMATCH, OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH, SEAL_INVALID, PREPUBLICATION_DRIFT, QUIESCENCE_FAILED, EXISTING_FINAL_INVALID, PUBLICATION_FAILED, FINAL_VERIFICATION_FAILED, CLEANUP_REFUSED, CLEANUP_FAILED. Preserve L4.1 reader reasons as causes; never translate into schedule/Label statuses or partial success.
unsupported_cases: Permanent artifact/user-data deletion, repair/migration/quarantine, residue adoption/sweep, permission changes, unregistered primitive/site, native fallback, same-PR implementation/contract modification or checker/exemption weakening.

Source/provider production qualification, capture runtime, key registry, reader/writer implementation, OpenD/provider operation, Catalog/CLI, release/deployment and host reboot/shutdown/logoff/sleep/hibernate/feature/BIOS/UEFI/bcdedit/ACL/network/RDP/firewall changes are not authorized by this design.

permanent_deletion.rationale: Only current-invocation uncommitted private staging may be internally removed after exact proof. No committed artifact, existing persistent/user asset, output root or ancestor can be deleted.

implementation_tests: SP-01: absent-target complete native publication, strict final reader and second physical closure.
SP-02/SP-03: existing equivalent no staging/writes; existing corrupt/conflicting/unsafe fails untouched with no staging.
SP-04/SP-05: simultaneous equivalent/conflicting full creators, winner immutability and reported/proven loser cleanup.
SP-06/SP-07: actual Windows empty/nonempty no-replace refusal; Linux EEXIST/ENOTEMPTY safe-proof, EXDEV and unsupported errno handling with no fallback.
SP-08/SP-09/SP-10/SP-11: real symlink/junction/reparse, hardlink, ADS/stream, aliases, mount/volume transition and unsafe-access rejection; Windows native links rather than DirEntry authority.
SP-12/SP-13/SP-14: staging substitution, identical-byte member replacement, security/filesystem drift refuse publication/rebind/cleanup without repair.
SP-15/SP-16: extra/hidden/case-aliased and missing members fail; cleanup partial creation must equal current ledger, not arbitrary subset.
SP-17/SP-18: manifest/source/evidence/receipt mutation, same-size drift and missing/nonempty/replaced marker fail; marker alone never commits.
SP-19/SP-20: checked-close failure after zero/some descendant closes gives zero rename calls; partial Windows quiescence rebind can safely clean only after all original records match.
SP-21/SP-22: rebind mismatch refuses without rmtree; atomic evidence installation; race loser cleanup proof and unchanged winner; idempotent success requires own cleanup.
SP-23/SP-24/SP-25: ambiguous committed interruption forbids rebind/rmtree; postcommit crash never rolls back; final reader failure preserves final and reports COMMITTED_INVALID.
SP-26/SP-27: relocation-independent artifact/source/evidence/logical IDs and zero provider/network/OpenD/current-time/mutable-Catalog fallback.

SP-28/SP-29: direct/forged/foreign/copied/reused seal/raw cleanup path rejected; exact approved unchanged BASE contract, one os.rename, one rmtree and one root-fd-relative flag-1 renameat2 site, no checker/exemption change.
SP-30/SP-31: cleanup-attempted no retry/ignore/chmod/sweep; all 81 state pairs (11 allowed,70 forbidden), no reseal/terminal reset/authority transfer.

SP-32/SP-33/SP-34/SP-35: independently qualified exact L4 native tuples only; seal/capture drift and caller mutation cannot enter bytes; unqualified source/keys/clock/completion fail; every section-13 crash checkpoint evidenced.

All canaries DESIGN-DEFINED / RUNTIME-DEFERRED in this PR. Distinguish mocks and skips from real exact-code native qualification. Preserve historical L3 and L4.1 results; current design inventory 7/16/44, conditional future Python surfaces 46, version 0.8.0 unchanged.
